__comment: FinOps overview dashboard per ADR-040. Skeleton — Athena query bodies are placeholder strings keyed off the CUR schema declared in infrastructure/terraform/finops-cur-athena.tf. Fill in actual SQL after first CUR delivery cycle (24-48h post-apply). Datasource UIDs are environment-specific; keep ${DS_*} variables and resolve at provisioning time via the Grafana provider's datasource binding.

panels.title: Monthly burn rate
panels.description: Project-wide spend trend, current month vs prior 3 months. Source: CUR via Athena.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT date_trunc('day', usage_start_date) AS time, SUM(line_item_unblended_cost) AS cost_usd FROM cur_view WHERE usage_start_date >= date_trunc('month', current_date - interval '3' month) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Cost by tier
panels.description: Stateful / stateless / shared / observability split. Source: CUR Tier tag.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT resource_tags_user_tier AS tier, SUM(line_item_unblended_cost) AS cost FROM cur_view WHERE billing_period_start = date_trunc('month', current_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Cost by component
panels.description: Backup / network / KMS / Logs / stateful / stateless / observability. Source: CUR Component tag.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT resource_tags_user_component AS component, SUM(line_item_unblended_cost) AS cost FROM cur_view WHERE billing_period_start = date_trunc('month', current_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Top 10 tenants by cost (current month)
panels.description: Per-tenant attribution. Joins CUR with tenant cost dimension propagated from pod label aegis.io/tenant-id via Container Insights. See scripts/finops/per-tenant-cost-attribution.sql Q1.

targets.rawSQL:
-- See scripts/finops/per-tenant-cost-attribution.sql Q1
SELECT tenant_id, SUM(compute_cost) AS compute, SUM(storage_cost) AS storage, SUM(backup_cost) AS backup, SUM(total_cost) AS total FROM tenant_cost_view WHERE billing_period_start = date_trunc('month', current_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Cost anomalies (7d)
panels.description: Count of anomalies detected by AWS Cost Anomaly Detector with absolute impact ≥ $100. Source: CloudWatch metric.

panels.title: Budget headroom (current month)
panels.description: Percentage of monthly budget consumed. Source: AWS Budgets via CloudWatch.

panels.title: Unit economics — $/tenant/month
panels.description: Average cost per active tenant per month. Trend visible across consolidation, SP commitment, scale events.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT date_trunc('month', billing_period_start) AS time, SUM(total_cost) / COUNT(DISTINCT tenant_id) AS cost_per_tenant FROM tenant_cost_view WHERE billing_period_start >= date_trunc('month', current_date - interval '6' month) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Savings Plan utilisation (7d)
panels.description: SP commitment used / committed. <80% sustained = SP over-provisioned; >100% = uncovered on-demand spend. See scripts/finops/per-tenant-cost-attribution.sql Q4.

targets.rawSQL:
-- See scripts/finops/per-tenant-cost-attribution.sql Q4
SELECT usage_date AS time, sp_utilization_pct FROM savings_plan_utilisation_view WHERE usage_date >= current_date - interval '7' day ORDER BY usage_date

title: FinOps Overview (per ADR-040)
